svg.text: How to read it. Section 1 is the introduction, 2 the overview, 3 the Lean formalization; A to O are the appendices of the proof. A citation is a key inside square brackets; [Str87, Str88] cites two. Nothing here reads the cited papers, and they are not linked yet.
